app.name: Maizon Twin IOS55 USBv4
app.short_description: Detect Twin USB 0810:0001 with IOS55 legacy HID v4
app.long_description: Automatic 25-second legacy HID USBv4 scan and capture of Twin input packets. Restores IOS58 for USB log saving. Requires installed IOS55. No NAND modification, no SD or Wiimote button needed.
